plan.goal: Explore and critique the UX of the Microsoft privacy system, covering primary settings, activity management, and ad settings, with checks for responsiveness, state changes, and error handling.
plan.summary: Start with the main dashboard (index.html), validate activity cards and privacy toggles. Then explore browse-history.html for filtering and deletion. Next, check ad-settings.html for toggle interactions. Finally, verify download-data.html and repeat key checks in mobile view. Ensure all pages and critical controls are exercised.
assumptions: All pages load without errors (prescan shows no load errors)
Interactive elements (toggles, buttons, links) function as expected
Mobile viewport has responsive layout adjustments
risk_hotspots: Modal dialogs (clear data, download confirmation) for proper dismissal
Toggle switches (ad settings, privacy toggles) for state persistence
Small tap targets (top navigation links) in mobile view

phases.title: Main Dashboard (index.html) Exploration
phases.objective: Validate activity cards, privacy toggles, and top navigation
key_checks: Click 'Manage browse activity' to ensure navigation to browse-history.html works
Interact with a privacy toggle (e.g., 'Voice activity') to check 'Saving…/Saved' feedback
Verify top navigation links (e.g., 'Privacy', 'Security') load correct pages
Check 'Download your data' link navigates to download-data.html
exit_criteria: All activity cards and privacy toggles interacted with, navigation links verified

phases.title: Browse History (browse-history.html) Management
phases.objective: Test filtering, deletion, and empty state
key_checks: Use 'Time range' and 'Device' filters to verify activity table updates
Delete a single activity row and check animation/state change
Click 'Clear all' to trigger modal, dismiss modal and confirm cancellation
Trigger empty state (e.g., delete all entries) and verify message
exit_criteria: Filtering, single delete, bulk delete (with modal), and empty state verified

phases.title: Ad Settings (ad-settings.html) Toggles
phases.objective: Validate master and per-service toggle interactions
key_checks: Toggle 'See ads that interest you' master switch and check sub-toggles update
Toggle a per-service switch (e.g., 'Microsoft consumer apps') and verify state
Check 'Manage LinkedIn ad preferences' link navigates correctly
Verify ad topic toggles (e.g., 'Technology News') work
exit_criteria: Master and per-service toggles interacted with, ad topic toggles verified

phases.title: Download Data (download-data.html) Configuration
phases.objective: Test data selection and confirmation flow
key_checks: Select/deselect data categories (e.g., 'Account profile', 'Browse activity')
Proceed through 'Time range' and 'How to deliver it' steps
Trigger download confirmation modal and dismiss it
Verify 'privacy dashboard' link navigates back to index.html
exit_criteria: Data categories selected, download flow (up to modal) verified

phases.title: Mobile Viewport Validation
phases.objective: Repeat critical checks in mobile view
key_checks: Check top navigation links for improved tap targets in mobile view
Re-interact with a privacy toggle and ad toggle in mobile view
Test 'Manage browse activity' navigation in mobile view
Verify modal dialogs (e.g., 'Clear all') are accessible in mobile
exit_criteria: Critical checks repeated in mobile view, responsive issues (e.g., tap targets) noted

coverage_targets.pages: Visit all 4 known HTML pages (index, browse-history, ad-settings, download-data)
coverage_targets.features: Exercise all visible toggles, buttons, filters, and modal dialogs
coverage_targets.mobile: Repeat at least 3 critical checks (e.g., toggle, navigation, modal) in mobile viewport

notes: Pay attention to 'Saving…/Saved' feedback for toggles, ensure modals close properly, and document any layout warnings (e.g., small tap targets)
